## Overview

Sync `recipes/models/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash.yaml` with the two changes merged to vllm-project/recipes after #61302 was cut (vllm-project/recipes#1136, vllm-project/recipes#1137). Recipes for vLLM-served models now live here (#61302); this catches the copy up before vllm-project/recipes#1095 switches recipes.vllm.ai to render from this repo.

## Claims

- Default variant is the `deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017` checkpoint, and `min_vllm_version` is 0.31.0 (installs from the 0.31.0 pip wheel); the launch checkpoint stays as a variant (vllm-project/recipes#1136).
- Adds the GB300 PD layout: DEP prefill / DEP16 decode (vllm-project/recipes#1137).

## Validation

- The file equals vllm-project/recipes main (`92fb889`) except the deprecated `meta.difficulty` line, which the recipes here drop; before this change it equaled the pre-#1136 version the same way.
- `node scripts/validate-source.mjs --source vllm --dir ~/vllm/recipes` from vllm-project/recipes main passes (schema + strict assemble + JSON API build). The `Recipes` check runs the same validation on this PR.

## Details

Docs-only: no Python or CI changes. vllm-project/recipes#1095 should merge after this one, otherwise recipes.vllm.ai would briefly render the older DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash recipe.
